text:
Assistant B employs more vivid and creative imagery, using striking similes (sea-colored eyes, lion’s paws, wind-untamed beard, thunderclap voice) to paint a unique, larger-than-life character. While Assistant A offers a grounded, detailed portrait, it relies on more conventional description and lacks the same level of imaginative language. Both meet the length constraint, but B better fulfills the request for “strong imagery and creative language.”
